Initial release of Niksphere Engine
Unified design for device authorization flow UI in IdP Broker matching React SPA frontend
Implement actor and identity architecture with universal admin client access, fail-fast validation, and full OpenAPI documentation
changed: Admin API error messages now consistently start with "Failed to <action>: <reason>", mirroring the existing "Successfully <action>..." convention on success, so the outcome is clear from the first word alone
fixed: Fix Admin API upload/publish responses nesting the success message under `data.message` instead of the top level, which caused the CLI and VS Code Extension to show a generic fallback message instead of the server''s actual text
Include configured routePrefix in verificationURI and external OAuth2 redirect URLs (IdP Broker)
Updated frontend dependencies to resolve security audit vulnerabilities
Added HTTP/HTTPS scheme annotations to OpenAPI specification generator for SDK compatibility
Return consistent 404 responses for unknown actors, clients, apps, and their sub-resources instead of an empty success or malformed error
Apply configured `idp_token_expiry_hours` / `idp_refresh_token_expiry_days` settings instead of ignoring them
Fix external identity provider login page leaking OAuth client secrets to the browser (IdP Broker)
Fix frontend login using an unregistered OAuth client ID

Initial release of Niksphere CLI
Require explicit server URL for environment authentication login (`env auth login`)
Centralized authentication handler with explicit 127.0.0.1 loopback binding for OAuth logins
Add `nik env actor` and `nik env client` commands for managing actors and OAuth clients

Add `nik dev mcp enable|disable|show` commands to register or remove the Niksphere MCP server (`nik mcp`) in AI client configuration files (Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, VS Code), with `--client` to target specific clients and `--json` on `show` for machine-readable client discovery
improvement: Improved CLI `--help` layout: displayed commands prior to options and unified flags under a single `Flags` section
Pressing Ctrl+C now cleanly cancels an in-progress command or login instead of showing a confusing error
Unified wording of success and error messages with the Engine and VS Code Extension across all `env app`, `env actor`, `env client`, and `env idp external` commands
Add detailed `--help` descriptions to `nik mcp` and `nik dev lsp` clarifying they are started by an AI client or editor as a subprocess, not meant to be run manually
fixed: Fix duplicated or reworded success/error messages on admin commands (e.g. "Successfully installed. App X ... successfully installed" or "failed to edit actor: Actor not found.") by relaying the Engine''s own message verbatim
Centralized server URL resolution across environment commands (`nik env ...`) to avoid silent fallback to `localhost`
Fix login and token refresh failing due to a retired, unregistered OAuth client ID
breaking: Move `nik dev integrate lsp` to `nik dev lsp` and remove the now-empty `nik dev integrate` command group
